name: rn-size-analyzer
description: React Native project, build, and release size analyzer with a local HTML dashboard. Helps developers understand why Android/iOS apps are large, which dependencies and assets contribute, and what changed between releases.
author: Satyam Narayan

scripts.test: npm run build && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test dist-test/tests/unit/*.test.js dist-test/tests/integration/*.test.js
scripts.test:unit: npm run build && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test dist-test/tests/unit/*.test.js
scripts.test:integration: npm run build && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test dist-test/tests/integration/*.test.js
